children: Summit Therapeutics announced updated HARMONi Phase III overall survival results showing a consistent OS benefit for ivonescimab plus chemotherapy versus placebo plus chemotherapy.
June 2026 analysis: global ITT OS HR 0.76 (95% CI: 0.61–0.95; nominal p=0.0151), median OS 16.8 vs 14.0 months.
Western subgroup with longer follow-up: OS HR 0.76 (95% CI: 0.52–1.10), median follow-up 23.2 months replicating Asian benefit.
No new safety signals in updated HARMONi data; safety profile remains acceptable and manageable.
Partner Akeso presented HARMONi-2: ivonescimab monotherapy vs pembrolizumab showed OS HR 0.73 (95% CI: 0.57–0.95; p=0.009); median OS 30.8 vs 22.6 months.
Summit’s U.S. BLA for ivonescimab is under review with a PDUFA goal date of November 14, 2026.
